name: prometheus.exporter.elasticsearch

arguments.name: address
arguments.description: HTTP API address of an Elasticsearch node.

arguments.name: all
arguments.description: Export stats for all nodes in the cluster. If used, this flag overrides the flag node.

arguments.name: ca
arguments.description: Path to PEM file that contains trusted Certificate Authorities for the Elasticsearch connection.

arguments.name: client_cert
arguments.description: Path to PEM file that contains the corresponding cert for the private key to connect to Elasticsearch.

arguments.name: client_private_key
arguments.description: Path to PEM file that contains the private key for client auth when connecting to Elasticsearch.

arguments.name: clusterinfo_interval
arguments.description: Cluster info update interval for the cluster label.

arguments.name: indices_settings
arguments.description: Export stats for settings of all indices of the cluster.

arguments.name: indices
arguments.description: Export stats for indices in the cluster.

arguments.name: node
arguments.description: Node’s name of which metrics should be exposed

arguments.name: shards
arguments.description: Export stats for shards in the cluster (implies indices).

arguments.name: slm
arguments.description: Export stats for SLM (Snapshot Lifecycle Management).

arguments.name: snapshots
arguments.description: Export stats for the cluster snapshots.

arguments.name: ssl_skip_verify
arguments.description: Skip SSL verification when connecting to Elasticsearch.

arguments.name: timeout
arguments.description: Timeout for trying to get stats from Elasticsearch.

blocks.description: Configure basic_auth for authenticating to the endpoint.

exported_fields.name: targets
exported_fields.description: The targets that can be used to collect exporter metrics.
